chunks: Whoever resides in Makkah for one year, tawaf is better for him than salat (prayer). Whoever resides for two years mixes between this and that. Whoever resides for three years, salat (prayer) becomes better for him.

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: more virtuous or superior in merit
key_terms.بِمَكَّةَ: in Makkah, the Sacred City where this ruling applies
key_terms.خَلَطَ: he combines or alternates between the two acts
key_terms.فَٱلطَّوَافُ: circumambulation of the Ka'bah as an act of worship

ai.seo_question: For a resident of Makkah, is tawaf better than salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith states a graduated preference in worship for one residing in Makkah: tawaf is superior during the first year, both tawaf and salat are combined in the second year, and salat becomes superior in the third year. It highlights the special merit of tawaf in the Sacred Precinct while also indicating a changing balance between forms of worship over extended residence.
